Adversary performed Kerberoasting against high-privilege service accounts (svc_sql_prod, svc_exchange_admin, svc_sccm) from domain controller DC-PROD-01. arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Launch from Office Application
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-nop -w hidden -encodedcommand'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566.001/
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts (rare)
author: SOC Team

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon DLL"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        hash = "3342fe4b"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 6A 40 68 00 30 00 00 6A 14 8D 91 }
        $b = "Crypt32" fullword ascii
        $c = "kernel32" fullword ascii
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.0" ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
